brief.question: What operational and disclosure controls should regional banks require before allowing relationship managers to use third-party LLM copilots when drafting credit memos?
brief.audience: Regional-bank credit risk, model risk, and front-line lending ops.
brief.scope: Synthetic source pack only; control map, human accountability evidence, counter-evidence (silent hallucination), phased adoption kill criteria. No live web.
brief.output: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): control map, accountability, counter-evidence, kill criteria. Registries and checklist separate.
brief.evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; do not treat vendor copilots as decision systems; disclose no independent review.
